The factored derivative has one crossing for every eta>0 by exact signs of A, B and their derivatives on the isolated (beta,alpha) interval; the implicit function theorem establishes strict noise monotonicity and asymptotics. Endpoint risk has unique midpoint minimizer by a strictly increasing scalar function of t(1-t). Symbolic identities, rational brackets and independent numerical quadrature replayed successfully in verify.py; finite checks do not establish infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: One noisy sensor reads a derivative of a cumulative stochastic trajectory, a natural experiment-design model. Integrated whole-path recovery and terminal-area recovery demand strictly distinct times for all noise, with a complete one-sensor classification, explicit algebraic limits and a quantitative loss ratio. It is not a restatement of direct point-observation designs, although numerical gain is modest; its value is the structural all-noise target mismatch and complete optimum law.
